name: KamLAND / KamLAND-Zen — dark matter searches
full_name: Kamioka Liquid Scintillator Antineutrino Detector and KamLAND-Zen dark-matter searches
summary: Large liquid-scintillator neutrino experiment and its xenon-loaded phase, searching both for dark-matter annihilation neutrinos and bound-state formation of charged excited dark matter with xenon.
detection_principle: KamLAND searches for astrophysical antineutrinos through inverse beta decay; KamLAND-Zen searches for MeV energy released when dark matter forms a bound state with a xenon nucleus.

key_parameters.value: WIMP mass 1 TeV, excited-state mass splitting 17 MeV

phases.name: KamLAND
phases.description: Antineutrino data constrain the dark-matter annihilation rate.

phases.name: KamLAND-Zen
phases.description: Xenon-loaded data test bound-state formation by charged excited-state WIMPs.

results.summary: KamLAND-Zen found no significant events; for the representative model, the recombination cross section times velocity is limited to 9.2×10⁻³⁰ cm³/s at 90% CL.
In the 8.3–30.8 MeV neutrino-energy interval with 6.72 kt·yr exposure, 18 candidate events were observed, compatible with background, constraining light-dark-matter pair annihilation into neutrinos.

science_scope: Explicit dark-matter studies with a multipurpose neutrino and double-beta-decay instrument, including indirect annihilation searches and a specific inelastic direct-capture model. Ordinary neutrino-oscillation measurements are not counted as dark-matter discoveries.
